sections.title: Questionnaire deadlines
sections.sql: select code,account,owner,due_on,questions,ready,blocked,readiness from questionnaire_readiness order by due_on

sections.title: Follow up
sections.sql: select * from security_attention order by rule,code

sections.title: Evidence behind each answer
sections.sql: select code,topic,owner,evidence_code,review_due_on,currency from answer_currency order by code

sections.title: Open responses
sections.sql: select owner,count(*) as responses,count(*) filter(where readiness<>'ready') as blocked from response_readiness where questionnaire_status='open' group by owner order by owner
